videos.title: 3 Foot Sweeps for No Gi BJJ (Judo/Wrestling/Jiu-Jitsu)
videos.whyUseful: Covers fundamental no-gi foot sweeps including de ashi barai, sasae tsurikomi ashi, and kouchi gari. Teaches the mechanics for setting up and timing sweeps against a resisting opponent in no-gi context.

videos.title: Harai-Tsurikomi-Ashi — Lift Pull Foot Sweep
videos.whyUseful: Shintaro Higashi, a Judo black belt with excellent teaching methodology, explains the mechanics behind ashi-waza (foot sweeps). Focuses on timing, off-balancing, and proper foot placement for effective sweeps.
